title: Chocolate Chunk Cookies
description: Chewy brown-butter cookies with big pools of chocolate.
steps: Whisk the browned butter with both sugars until glossy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt until just combined, then fold in the chocolate.
Chill the dough for 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 350°F.
Scoop 2-tablespoon balls onto a lined sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are set.
notes: Dough keeps 3 days in the fridge and improves with rest.
